articleBodyHtml:
Discussion About Moving Babies to Another Den and Future Plans

The speakers discussed the need to move the babies to another den, with one person explicitly stating, 'Take them to another den.' This indicates a clear action plan related to the babies' safety or relocation.

There was a mention of possibly continuing the activity in the next three hours, as one person said, 'Because there are not going to be any crazy developments. Within the next three hours.' This suggests that the group is planning to continue with their current task or activity shortly.

The group also discussed last-minute additions to the story and whether they could kill each other, with one person saying, 'I don't think we can kill each other. But. I'm not sure. That was just a wolf harum.' This indicates a discussion about the narrative direction and potential actions within the story.
